_comment: Rerank stemming: 'testing flakes' must top-rank the item that says 'test flake'. Baseline (raw-includes token hits) prefers the literal-'testing' decoy; passes once rerank counts stem hits (Phase 1.1).

items.subject: store teardown flake
items.text: Insight: the vitest test flake comes from store teardown — the db handle stays open on Windows runners, so rmdir fails intermittently.

items.subject: workspace setup
items.text: Insight: testing setup uses vitest workspaces so integration suites share one config.

items.subject: api pagination
items.text: Decision: cursor pagination for the events api. Alternatives: offset pagination rejected for skew under concurrent writes.
